entities.name: Hiroaki Mitsuya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hiroaki Mitsuya  is a Japanese virologist famous for his role in discovery of the anti-HIV drug zidovudine (AZT) as well as other anti-AIDS drugs including didanosine (ddI) and zalcitabine (ddC).
